segment_contamination_dimensions: Permanent large-span industrial/warehouse building buyers (Prefabricated Industrial Buildings, Prefabricated Warehouse, Pre Engineered Building Structure, Pre Engineered Steel Building, Prefabricated Steel Buildings) — these buyers seek fixed, non-relocatable structures at industrial scale, not compact portable/relocatable cabins; names implying permanent industrial sheds or large-span steel buildings are blocked.

Agricultural structure buyers (Agricultural Greenhouses, Greenhouse, Polyhouse, Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse, Mini Greenhouse, Greenhouse Structure, Mist Chamber) — entirely different buyer persona (farmers, horticulturalists) with no overlap with portable cabin buyers; any greenhouse or polyhouse terminology is blocked.

Labour colony buyers served by the dedicated sibling MCAT 'Prefabricated Labor Colony' (ID 179245) — while portable buildings may include bunk houses, names that exclusively target large-scale prefabricated labour colony projects are blocked to avoid direct collision with that sibling.
Prefabricated school building buyers served by sibling MCAT 'Prefabricated School Building' (ID 154059) — names exclusively targeting permanent prefab school construction are blocked.

Prefabricated hospital/isolation ward buyers served by siblings 'Prefabricated Hospitals' (ID 159520) and 'Prefabricated Isolation Ward' (ID 444552) — names exclusively targeting permanent medical facility construction are blocked.

Tensile/membrane structure buyers (Tensile Structures, Modular Tensile Structure, Tensile Membrane Structures, Auditorium Tensile Structure, Gazebo Tensile Structure) — fabric/membrane canopy buyers with no overlap with steel-framed portable cabin buyers; tensile structure terminology is blocked.

RCC construction buyers (RCC Labour Quarter, ID 216129) — permanent reinforced concrete construction buyers are incompatible with portable/relocatable building buyers; RCC or permanent concrete terminology is blocked.
